content:
name: Pages reviews

on:
  pull_request:
    types: [closed]
  schedule:
    - cron: "23 4 * * *"
  workflow_dispatch:

concurrency:
  group: pages-reviews
  cancel-in-progress: false

permissions:
  contents: write

jobs:
  prune:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v5
        with:
          ref: ${{ github.event.repository.default_branch }}
      - uses: pnpm/setup@v2
        with:
          runtime: node@24
          cache: true
          install: false
      - run: pnpm install --frozen-lockfile
      - name: Git identity for gh-pages commits
        run: |
          git config user.name "github-actions[bot]"
          git config user.email "41898282+github-actions[bot]@users.noreply.github.com"
      - name: Remove the review for a closed pull request
        if: github.event_name == 'pull_request'
        run: pnpm exec tsx scripts/pages-review.ts prune --pr ${{ github.event.pull_request.number }}
      - name: Drop reviews older than 30 days
        if: github.event_name != 'pull_request'
        run: pnpm exec tsx scripts/pages-review.ts prune --ttl-days 30
